events.description: Honor those who served at A Salute to Veterans on Wednesday, November 11, 2026, in the Beer Garden! Join former U.S. Navy SEAL Robert J. O'Neill and Michael Smerconish for an engaging conversation as we celebrate Veterans Day and recognize the courage, dedication, and sacrifices of our nation's veterans. Gather for a meaningful evening of reflection, gratitude, and compelling stories in honor of the men and women who have served our country. Tickets are $50, and doors open at 6pm.<br><br>Robert O'Neill is one of the country's most highly decorated Navy SEAL combat veterans, involved in our nation's most strategic military campaigns, including the mission to kill Osama Bin Laden. By the time he was honorably discharged after almost 17 years of service, O'Neill held combat leadership roles in over 400 missions across four different theaters of war. Among his 52 decorations are two Silver Stars, four Bronze Stars with Valor, a Joint Service Commendation Medal with Valor, and three Presidential Unit citations. O'Neill is the author of The Operator, his New York Times bestselling account of his years as a SEAL and the hunt for Bin Laden. Today, he is a public speaker, security consultant, philanthropist and FOX News contributor. Through his charity, the Special Operators Transition Foundation, O'Neill works to raise awareness and financial support for special operations military personnel making the difficult transition from the battlefield to the boardroom. He is from Butte, Montana.<br><br>Don't miss your chance to join in conversation with former U.S Navy Seal Robert J. O'Neill and Michael Smerconish in the Beer Garden!

events.title: WMGK presents Grand Funk Railroad
events.short_description: Grand Funk Railroad, the legendary "American Band," continues to electrify audiences more than five decades after their 1969 debut. Founding members Don Brewer and Mel Schacher lead an all-star lineup delivering hard-driving rock classics like We're an American Band, The Loco-Motion, and Some Kind of Wonderful on their Still Shinin' On Tour 2026. With over 25 million albums sold, multiple platinum hits, and an unmatched live energy, Grand Funk remains one of America's most powerful and enduring rock acts. Doors open at 7pm.
events.description: "You cannot talk about rock in the 1970s without talking about Grand Funk Railroad!" -- David Fricke, Rolling Stone Magazine<br><br>Born in the industrial heart of Flint, Michigan, Grand Funk Railroad formed in 1969 and quickly cemented their place in rock history as one of America's most powerful live acts. Now, more than five decades later, this legendary band is still comin' to your town to help you party it down - bringing the same explosive energy and crowd-shaking sound to 2026 tour dates across the nation for their Still Shinin' On Tour.<br><br>Affectionately known as The American Band, Grand Funk Railroad continues to pack venues across the country, connecting generations of fans with their unmistakable mix of hard-driving rock, soulful vocals, and anthemic hits. Founding members Don Brewer (vocals and drums, and writer/singer of the iconic "We're an American Band") and Mel Schacher (bass, the thunder behind the groove) are joined by a lineup of all-star talent: the ever-versatile Tim Cashion (affectionately known as "Dr. Tim") on lead vocals and keys, who - in the past - has hit the road with Robert Palmer and Bob Seger; and guitar slinger and veteran of Bob Seger's Silver Bullet Band Mark Chatfield.<br><br>Their influence can still be heard in the DNA of rock icons like Van Halen, Bon Jovi, Foreigner, and Journey. Grand Funk's music endures not only on the airwaves - thanks to mega-hits like We're an American Band, I'm Your Captain/Closer to Home, The Loco-Motion, and Some Kind of Wonderful--but also on big screens and TV campaigns. From Disney's The Country Bears to General Motors commercials, and blockbuster films like Radio and Sahara, their songs remain a cultural touchstone.<br><br>With more than 25 million albums sold, 19 charting singles, 8 Top 40 hits, and two No. 1 smashes, Grand Funk has earned 7 gold and 10 platinum certifications - including 2022 platinum awards for both We're an American Band and Some Kind of Wonderful.<br><br>Following the success of last year's AMERICAN BAND TOUR 2025, the STILL SHININ' ON TOUR 2026 keeps the train rolling. Whether you're a lifelong fan or discovering Grand Funk for the first time, there's no better time to experience one of rock's most enduring bands.<br><br>Don't miss your chance to see them LIVE at the <span class='nowrap'>Xcite Center</span>. Doors open at 7pm.

events.description: Tim Dillon is a stand-up comedian, writer, and actor known for his no-holds-barred humor and incisive social commentary.<br><br>In 2025, Dillon released his highly anticipated stand-up special, I'm Your Mother on Netflix worldwide. He tours theaters internationally and has been a guest on The Joe Rogan Experience over 15 times. On-screen, Dillon starred in Eli Roth's box office hit Thanksgiving and appeared in Todd Phillips' Joker: Folie à Deux.<br><br>Don't miss your chance to see him live at the #1 Casino in Pennsylvania!

events.title: Jodeci
events.subtitle: 35th Anniversary Tour of Forever My Lady
events.short_description: Jodeci is one of the most influential R&amp;B groups of all time, known for blending soulful harmonies with hip-hop swagger. With timeless hits like Forever My Lady, Come &amp; Talk to Me, and Cry for You, the group's electrifying performances and signature sound helped define 1990s R&amp;B and continue to captivate audiences around the world.
events.description: Jodeci is one of the most influential R&amp;B groups of all time. Establishing themselves as a trendsetting force throughout the culture with their signature style, soulful harmonies, and chart-topping hits, members K-Ci, DeVante Swing, JoJo, and Mr. Dalvin have sold over 20 million records worldwide, and achieved three #1 albums on the Billboard Top R&amp;B Albums chart. In 2024, the band headlined their first, sold-out Las Vegas Residency at the House of Blues- The Show, The After Party, The Vegas Residency named after their multi-platinum album of the same now which now celebrates 30 years with an expanded digital edition and deluxe vinyl. In 2023, Jodeci headlined their own highly anticipated Summer Block Party Tour selling out shows from coast to coast, joined by SWV and Dru Hill.<br><br>Their debut album Forever My Lady (1991) was a huge success reaching #1 on the Billboard Top R&amp;B Albums chart in its first week of release, and featured hit single, "Forever My Lady," which climbed to #1 on the Billboard Hot R&amp;B/Hip-Hop Singles and Tracks chart. The album's classic hits "Come &amp; Talk To Me," and "Stay," also topped the charts reaching #1 on the Billboard Hot R&amp;B/Hip-Hop Songs chart. Their second album, Diary Of A Mad Band (1993) went #1 on the Billboard Top R&amp;B Albums chart, penning their hit single, "Cry For You" which landed at #1 on the Billboard Hot R&amp;B/Hip-Hop Singles and Tracks chart. Jodeci's third album, The Show, The After Party, The Hotel (1995) gave the group their third #1 album on the Billboard Top R&amp;B Albums chart, producing hit songs "Freek'n You," and "Love U 4 Life."<br><br>In 2021, Jodeci reunited and signed with P Music Group for management by Founder and CEO Michael Paran. To kick off their reunion, Jodeci joined Charlie Wilson and New Edition for a 30-city tour in 2022, on the critically acclaimed "The Culture Tour." Jodeci's legendary sound and style have shaped the world of R&amp;B and continue to influence a new generation of artists.<br><br>Don't miss Jodeci at the #1 casino in Pennsylvania!

events.description: Iconic actor, best-selling author, Grammy Award-winning comedian, activist and America's sweetheart of Cannabis Tommy Chong is legendary for his invaluable contribution to American counter-culture as part of the iconic comedy duo Cheech &amp; Chong, and with a name synonymous with cannabis, launched a duo brand with his long-time collaborative partner, Cheech Marin - CHEECH &amp; CHONG'S CANNABIS Co. (https://www.cheechandchongscannabis.com/).<br><br>Six gold records and eight films, for which Chong also co-wrote and directed, Cheech &amp; Chong defined an era, pioneering a unique brand of "stoner-comedy" which has remained at the forefront for decades since with their hilariously irreverent, satirical, no-holds-barred comedy routines. UP IN SMOKE became the highest grossing comedy of the time, topping $100 million at the box office. Chong is also highly recognizable from his role as the aging hippie photo store worker "Leo" on FOX's "That 70's Show" and dozens more roles across TV and film.<br><br>After a nine-month prison sentence in 2004 for shipping bongs to Pennsylvania, the comic became a passionate advocate for cannabis freedom and fairness. In a time where cannabis had to be talked about in whispers, Tommy was a loud voice for the advocacy movement, working tirelessly to destigmatize the use of this healing plant. Now that society has moved in a more positive direction regarding the medicinal and recreational use of cannabis, Tommy's voice continues to ring out loudly, touting its benefits and place in society.<br><br>Most recently, Tommy and Cheech released CHEECH AND CHONG'S LAST MOVIE (in theaters now available on Paramount+), a documentary style feature film exploring over 5-decades of the duo's career in standup, music, film, life beyond the lens, and legacy and influencer on pop culture as we know it today<br><br>Don't miss your chance to see him LIVE at the #1 casino in Pennsylvania! Doors open at 7pm.
